decision.explanation: The question asks for the 'main use' of Los Angeles’ Strategic Extraction and Restoration zones. Two distinct but valid interpretations emerge from the provided sources. Document d1 explicitly states that the main use of SERZ was to identify and target high-crime areas with a focus on precrime (D1S3). Document d2 describes how the physical locations of the former SER zones have been repurposed as thriving art galleries (D2S2). These two answers refer to different aspects of the zones—functional purpose during operation (d1) and current physical use post-discontinuation (d2). Both are valid and complementary, and neither contradicts the other.
